newsitem.title: USA: Fed intervenes via 3-day system RPs, more possible.
newsitem.headline: Fed intervenes via 3-day system RPs, more possible.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of three-day fixed-system repurchase agreements on Monday.

Economists had expected a three- or four-day system operation. Because the Fed intervened earlier than its standard time of 1030 EDT/1430 GMT, analysts say the possibility exists of another operation later Monday morning.
Federal funds were quoted at 5.56 percent, just above the Fed's current official target level of 5.5 percent.
Last Friday, the effective fed funds rate was 5.53 percent, with a trading range of 5.375-5.75 percent.
